en.title: Paul Feig Trades Comedy for Horror with Blumhouse's 'Detention'
en.summary: The director behind beloved comedies like 'Bridesmaids' is venturing into darker territory for his next project. Feig is set to helm the horror thriller 'Detention' for Blumhouse Atomic Monster.
en.body:
Get ready for a serious shift in tone from **Paul Feig**. Known for bringing us laugh-out-loud hits like **Bridesmaids** and **Spy**, the director is now diving headfirst into the world of horror with **Detention**. This new project is set to be produced under the banner of **Blumhouse Atomic Monster**, the powerhouse behind recent hits like **M3GAN** and **The Black Phone**, and will also see involvement from **Michael Bay’s Platinum Dunes**. The script comes from **Daniel Gold**, who also penned the upcoming **Ryan Gosling** and **Will Ferrell** movie **Tough Guys**, indicating a strong pedigree behind the scenes.

While details about the plot of **Detention** are being kept tightly under wraps, the confirmation that it's a horror thriller is enough to spark considerable intrigue. Feig has previously explored the thriller genre, most notably with **A Simple Favor**, but this marks his first full-fledged foray into outright horror. This pivot is particularly noteworthy given Feig's established success in comedy, suggesting a desire to explore different facets of filmmaking and perhaps a keen interest in the genre's ability to blend scares with sharp storytelling.

## A New Direction for a Beloved Director

This announcement is sure to have fans of **Paul Feig** buzzing with a mix of curiosity and excitement. For years, he's been a go-to director for smart, female-led comedies that are both hilarious and heartfelt. Now, the prospect of him applying that same talent for character development and pacing to a horror narrative is a fascinating one. The collaboration with **Blumhouse Atomic Monster** is a perfect fit, as the studio has a proven track record of nurturing genre films and working with filmmakers to create unique and often commercially successful horror experiences.

> "Following the success of *The Housemaid,* Paul Feig is looking to get even darker with his next thriller, as he is coming on to direct *Detention* for Blumhouse Atomic Monster and Platinum Dunes."

The involvement of **Platinum Dunes** further solidifies the project's potential. Known for their work on franchises like **The Purge** and **A Quiet Place**, they bring a wealth of experience in producing high-concept, scary movies. The script being a spec acquisition from **Daniel Gold** also suggests it was a project with enough inherent merit to attract these major players.

## What This Means for Horror Fans

**Detention** represents a significant potential addition to the modern horror landscape. The blend of a director known for his comedic timing and character work with the established horror expertise of **Blumhouse** and **Platinum Dunes** could result in something truly original. Will Feig lean into psychological terror, jump scares, or perhaps a darkly comedic horror that plays to his strengths? The possibilities are, quite literally, thrilling. This is a film that cinephiles and casual moviegoers alike will be eager to learn more about as it develops.

## What's Next

While no specific release date has been announced for **Detention**, it is anticipated to arrive in 2026. As of now, no cast members have been attached, leaving plenty of room for speculation. We'll be keeping a close eye on casting announcements and any further plot details that emerge from this exciting new venture.

content_raw: Daniel Gold, who wrote the upcoming Ryan Gosling-Will Ferrell movie 'Tough Guys,' penned the feature as a spec, which also has Michael Bay’s Platinum Dunes involved.
